images.title: The units of time
images.purpose: Show the two ladders of the chapter, 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 minute = 60 seconds, and the rule for a p.m. time in the 24-hour format.
images.composition: A caption at the top and three rows, each with a left box, an arrow with its rule and a right box.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption The units of time in this chapter in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (40 px), left edge at x 200, about y 70. THREE ROWS, each a left box, a straight arrow and a right box. Every box is a rounded rectangle (corner radius 18 px) 300 px wide and 110 px high with a dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px) and bold text (40 px) centred inside. Left boxes span x 200 to 500, right boxes span x 960 to 1260. ROW 1 (y 130 to 240): left box teal blue #0072B2 with white text 1 hour, right box teal blue #0072B2 with white text 60 minutes. ROW 2 (y 340 to 450): left box amber #E69F00 with dark text 1 minute, right box amber #E69F00 with dark text 60 seconds. ROW 3 (y 550 to 660): left box reddish purple #CC79A7 with white text 07:45 p.m., right box reddish purple #CC79A7 with white text 19:45 hours. ARROWS: in each row one thick dark #2B2B2B straight arrow (8 px) from x 520 to x 940 at the row's middle (y 185, y 395 and y 605), arrowhead at the right end, with a label centred above it at x 730 (40 px, bold, dark): × 60 in rows 1 and 2, and add 12 to the hour in row 3. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: The units of time in this chapter
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 3 rows, 6 boxes or 3 arrows
the label × 60 on row 3, or add 12 to the hour on rows 1 and 2
images.takeaway: 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds, and a p.m. time adds 12 to the hour in the 24-hour format.
images.description: Three rows of a box, an arrow and a box: 1 hour to 60 minutes, 1 minute to 60 seconds, and 07:45 p.m. to 19:45 hours.
images.context: Concept image for Chapter Revision. It follows the ideas of the units and of the 24-hour format in your maths book and uses the plan's own example of 07:45 p.m.
images.teaching_notes: Read each row aloud as a rule. The slip to watch: using 100 in place of 60.

image_decisions.why: The three rows put the chapter's unit rules in one picture for the revision.
